geometry_method: Boundary-preserving polynomial z deformation of existing meshes
coordinate_semantics: Native program z points down; positive coefficient moves surface downward.
remaining_pilot_restrictions: x/y coordinates, planform, length=5 and mirror symmetry preserved for this pilot; these are not new user constraints.
sampling: Retain all 178 valid pilot shapes; fill each parent quota from deterministic 8D Latin hypercubes, equal parameter bounds, ordered rejection sampling; no performance-based acceptance.
validity_scope: Fixed-XY graph and every projected triangle overlap vertex checked for both triangulations; all pilot cases cross-checked and new cases sampled with original 3D audit. No volume filter; no mechanism or design-shock validation.
geometry_audit: Fixed-XY piecewise-linear graph and full projected triangle overlay gap certificate, both diagonal splits; compare all 192 pilot cases and an independent new-case sample to the original 3D audit.
numeric_acceleration: Same gas/pressure equations and branch definitions, safeguarded Newton roots with bisection fallback; validate against stored original P2 and direct reference calculations.
